+\"\"\"Dependency-free client for private text prompts with OpenAI Responses.\"\"\"

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, Optional, Union
+
+
+DEFAULT_BASE_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60.0
+
+__all__ = [
+    \"DEFAULT_BASE_URL\",
+    \"DEFAULT_TIMEOUT\",
+    \"OpenAIClient\",
+    \"OpenAIClientError\",
+    \"OpenAIRequestError\",
+    \"OpenAIResponseError\",
+    \"extract_text\",
+    \"send_prompt\",
+]
+
+
+class OpenAIClientError(RuntimeError):
+    \"\"\"Base exception for client failures.\"\"\"
+
+
+class OpenAIRequestError(OpenAIClientError):
+    \"\"\"Raised when the request cannot be sent or completed.\"\"\"
+
+
+class OpenAIResponseError(OpenAIClientError):
+    \"\"\"Raised when OpenAI returns an unsuccessful or invalid response.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        message: str,
+        *,
+        status_code: Optional[int] = None,
+        request_id: Optional[str] = None,
+        error_type: Optional[str] = None,
+        error_code: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.request_id = request_id
+        self.error_type = error_type
+        self.error_code = error_code
+
+
+class OpenAIClient:
+    \"\"\"Send text prompts to the Responses API using only the standard library.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        api_key: [REDACTED_SECRET] = None,
+        model: Optional[str] = None,
+        base_url: Optional[str] = None,
+        timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+        organization: Optional[str] = None,
+        project: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise OpenAIRequestError(
+                \"An API key is required; pass api_key or set OPENAI_API_KEY.\"
+            )
+
+        self.model = model
+        self.base_url = (base_url or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_BASE_URL\") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL).rstrip(\"/\")
+        if timeout <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(\"timeout must be greater than zero\")
+        self.timeout = timeout
+        self.organization = organization or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_ORGANIZATION\")
+        self.project = project or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_PROJECT\")
+        self._validate_base_url(self.base_url)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_base_url(base_url: str) -> None:
+        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url)
+        if parsed.scheme "'!= "https":
+            raise ValueError("base_url must use HTTPS")
+        if not parsed.netloc or parsed.username or parsed.password:
+            raise ValueError("base_url must be an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials")
+
+    def _headers(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
+        headers = {
+            "Authorization": "Bearer " + str(self.api_key),
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+            "User-Agent": "openai-client/1.0",
+        }
+        if self.organization:
+            headers["OpenAI-Organization"] = self.organization
+        if self.project:
+            headers["OpenAI-Project"] = self.project
+        return headers
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _redact_prompt(message: str, prompt: str) -> str:
+        if prompt:
+            message = message.replace(prompt, "[prompt]")
+        return message
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _decode_error(
+        error: urllib.error.HTTPError,
+        prompt: str,
+    ) -> OpenAIResponseError:
+        request_id = error.headers.get("x-request-id")
+        payload: Any
+        try:
+            raw_body = error.read()
+        except OSError:
+            payload = None
+        else:
+            try:
+                payload = json.loads(raw_body.decode("utf-8"))
+            except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+                payload = None
+
+        error_detail = payload.get("error") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
+        if not isinstance(error_detail, dict):
+            error_detail = {}
+
+        detail = error_detail.get("message")
+        if isinstance(detail, str) and detail:
+            message = OpenAIClient._redact_prompt(detail, prompt)
+        else:
+            message = "OpenAI returned HTTP status {}.".format(error.code)
+
+        error_type = error_detail.get("type")
+        error_code = error_detail.get("code")
+        return OpenAIResponseError(
+            message,
+            status_code=error.code,
+            request_id=request_id,
+            error_type=error_type if isinstance(error_type, str) else None,
+            error_code=error_code if isinstance(error_code, str) else None,
+        )
+
+    def send_prompt(
+        self,
+        prompt: str,
+        *,
+        model: Optional[str] = None,
+        instructions: Optional[str] = None,
+        max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Send one private text prompt and return the raw Responses object."""
+
+        if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt:
+            raise ValueError("prompt must be a non-empty string")
+
+        selected_model = model or self.model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL")
+        if not selected_model:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "A model is required; pass model or set OPENAI_MODEL."
+            )
+        if instructions is not None and (
+            not isinstance(instructions, str) or not instructions
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("instructions must be a non-empty string")
+        if max_output_tokens is not None:
+            if isinstance(max_output_tokens, bool) or max_output_tokens <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("max_output_tokens must be a positive integer")
+
+        body: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "model": selected_model,
+            "input": prompt,
+            "store": False,
+        }
+        if instructions is not None:
+            body["instructions"] = instructions
+        if max_output_tokens is not None:
+            body["max_output_tokens"] = max_output_tokens
+
+        encoded_body = json.dumps(
+            body,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+        endpoint = self.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/responses"
+        request = urllib.request.Request(
+            endpoint,
+            data=encoded_body,
+            headers=self._headers(),
+            method="POST",
+        )
+
+        try:
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
+                status = getattr(response, "status", None) or response.getcode()
+                response_id = response.headers.get("x-request-id")
+                raw_response = response.read()
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+            raise self._decode_error(error, prompt) from None
+        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as error:
+            reason = getattr(error, "reason", None)
+            detail = str(reason) if reason is not None else type(error).__name__
+            raise OpenAIRequestError(
+                "Could not reach the OpenAI Responses API: {}".format(detail)
+            ) from None
+
+        if status < 200 or status >= 300:
+            raise OpenAIResponseError(
+                "OpenAI returned HTTP status {}.".format(status),
+                status_code=status,
+                request_id=response_id,
+            )
+        try:
+            decoded = json.loads(raw_response.decode("utf-8"))
+        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+            raise OpenAIResponseError(
+                "OpenAI returned a response that was not valid JSON.",
+                status_code=status,
+                request_id=response_id,
+            ) from None
+        if not isinstance(decoded, dict):
+            raise OpenAIResponseError(
+                "OpenAI returned an unexpected response payload.",
+                status_code=status,
+                request_id=response_id,
+            )
+        return decoded
+
+
+def send_prompt(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    api_key: [REDACTED_SECRET] = None,
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None,
+    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    instructions: Optional[str] = None,
+    max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
+    organization: Optional[str] = None,
+    project: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Send a single text prompt without creating a reusable client."""
+
+    client = OpenAIClient(
+        api_key=[REDACTED_SECRET]
+        model=model,
+        base_url=base_url,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        organization=organization,
+        project=project,
+    )
+    return client.send_prompt(
+        prompt,
+        instructions=instructions,
+        max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
+    )
+
+
+def extract_text(response: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Extract assistant text from a Responses API object."""
+
+    output_text = response.get("output_text")
+    if isinstance(output_text, str):
+        return output_text
+
+    output = response.get("output")
+    if not isinstance(output, list):
+        return ""
+
+    parts = []
+    for item in output:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "message":
+            continue
+        content = item.get("content")
+        if not isinstance(content, list):
+            continue
+        for part in content:
+            if (
+                isinstance(part, dict)
+                and part.get("type") == "output_text"
+                and isinstance(part.get("text"), str)
+            ):
+                parts.append(part["text"])
+    return "".join(parts)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(
+        "Import openai_client and call send_prompt(); prompts are not read "
+        "from the command line to avoid exposing them in shell history."
+    )
